meta.library_note: 30 rail and heavy highway construction modules (traffic control, railroad protection, earthwork, drainage, walls, paving, bridges, track, turnouts, grade crossings, signals, catenary, platforms, lighting and ITS, roadside safety, closeout), authored by VissRad. Demonstration norms, not market or benchmark data: calibrate to your own history before a plan is issued.

event.name: State Route Widening, Interchange, Two Bridges and Rail Siding (synthetic demo)
event.owner: Example State DOT and Example Railroad (synthetic)

materials.desc: Silt fence, inlet protection and controls
MSE wall panels, straps and select fill
Light or catenary pole with foundation
Temporary concrete barrier, rental and moves

modules.name: Mobilization, field office and plant
modules.desc: Mobilize the project: construction schedule and plans approved, field office and laydown, haul roads, survey control, and an on-site asphalt or concrete batch plant where the job sets one up.

queries.prompt: On-site asphalt or concrete batch plant?

tasks.desc: Plans, permits and baseline schedule approved
Field office, laydown and staging yards ({YARDS})
Set up and certify the batch plant

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Maintenance of traffic, by phase
modules.desc: Set and maintain the traffic control for each construction phase: signs and portable message boards, temporary barrier and attenuators, lane shifts and crossovers, temporary striping, and the switch between phases.

tasks.desc: Build temporary crossovers and detour pavement
Set and move temporary barrier, attenuators and temporary striping
Final traffic switch and remove temporary traffic control

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Railroad protection and track-time windows
modules.desc: Work on or near an operating railroad: the railroad’s right-of-entry and insurance, roadway worker protection training, flagging protection (RWIC) for every shift near the track, and track-time windows booked with the dispatcher.

queries.prompt: Railroad review and right-of-entry lead time

tasks.desc: Right-of-entry, insurance and railroad plan review
Roadway worker protection training and on-track safety plan
Book track-time windows with the dispatcher ({WIND})

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Erosion control and stormwater (SWPPP)
modules.desc: The stormwater pollution prevention plan in the field: perimeter controls, inlet protection, sediment basins and construction entrances, weekly and rain-event inspections, and removal when the site is stabilized.

tasks.desc: Perimeter controls, inlet protection and entrances

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Clearing, grubbing and removals
modules.desc: Clear and grub the right-of-way, remove existing pavement, curb, structures and fencing, and haul the debris off site.

queries.prompt: Existing structures or culverts to demolish?

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Roadway excavation and embankment
modules.desc: Mass earthwork: cut, haul, place and compact embankment in lifts with density tests, borrow where cut and fill do not balance, and fine grading to subgrade.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Subgrade stabilization and aggregate base
modules.desc: Prepare the pavement foundation: lime or cement treated subgrade, aggregate base course in lifts, and proof rolling and density acceptance before paving.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Storm drainage: pipe, inlets and manholes
modules.desc: Storm sewer and cross drains: trench and shore, bed and lay pipe, inlets, manholes and headwalls, backfill in lifts with density tests, and the mandrel and camera inspection.

tasks.desc: Trench, shore and lay pipe ({LF} ft)

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Box culverts
modules.desc: Precast or cast-in-place box culverts under the roadway or track: diversion and dewatering, excavation and bedding, set or form and pour the barrels, wingwalls and headwalls, and backfill.

tasks.desc: Set or form and pour barrels

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Retaining walls (MSE or cast-in-place)
modules.desc: Retaining walls at ramps and bridge approaches: leveling pad, panels with soil reinforcement and select fill in lifts (MSE), or footing and stem walls (cast-in-place), with coping and drainage.

tasks.desc: Erect panels or form and pour stems
Select backfill and straps in lifts

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Utility relocations and adjustments
modules.desc: Water, sewer, gas, power and telecom conflicts: coordinate the owners’ own crews, relocate the lines in the contract, adjust valves and manholes to grade, and keep the relocations off the critical path.

queries.prompt: Water and sewer relocated by the contractor
Valves and manholes adjusted to grade

tasks.desc: Adjust valves and manholes to grade

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Asphalt paving (mill and overlay or full depth)
modules.desc: Hot-mix asphalt by course: mill and patch, tack, base, intermediate and surface courses with a material transfer vehicle, joint density and ride acceptance, and the shoulders.

tasks.desc: Shoulders, joint density and ride acceptance

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Concrete paving (slipform)
modules.desc: Jointed plain or continuously reinforced concrete pavement: trim the base, set dowel baskets and tie bars, slipform pave, texture and cure, saw and seal the joints, and thickness and smoothness acceptance.

tasks.desc: Trim base and set string line

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Curb, gutter, sidewalk and median barrier
modules.desc: Machine-placed curb and gutter, sidewalks and ramps, and slipformed or cast-in-place concrete median barrier.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Bridge foundations: piles and drilled shafts
modules.desc: Deep foundations for abutments and bents: driven steel or concrete piles with test piles and dynamic monitoring, or drilled shafts with casing, reinforcing cages, tremie concrete and integrity testing.

queries.prompt: In water or on a work trestle?

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Bridge substructure: footings, columns, caps and abutments
modules.desc: Footings and pile caps, columns, bent caps and abutments with backwalls: forms, reinforcing, embeds and bearing seats, concrete, cure and strip.

tasks.desc: Bent caps and abutments with backwalls
Bearing seats, survey and release for girders

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Girder erection
modules.desc: Set precast concrete or steel girders: bearings, erection under lane or track closures with the crane picks and temporary bracing, diaphragms and cross frames, bolting, and the release to deck work.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Bridge deck and barrier
modules.desc: Deck forms and overhangs, reinforcing, the deck pour with the finishing machine and curing, then barrier rail, expansion joints, approach slabs and grooving.

tasks.desc: Barrier rail, joints and approach slabs

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Bridge rehabilitation and deck overlay
modules.desc: Repair an existing bridge under traffic: hydrodemolition or scarifying, partial and full-depth deck repairs, joint replacement, latex or polymer overlay, bearing and substructure repairs, by stage.

tasks.desc: Stage switch and reopen to traffic

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Track bed and subballast
modules.desc: Prepare the track bed for new or realigned track: roadbed grading to the template, ditches and under-track drainage, geotextile, subballast in lifts with density tests, and bottom ballast.

tasks.desc: Grade roadbed to the template and cut ditches

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: New track construction
modules.desc: Build new track on a prepared bed: distribute and space ties, thread and fasten rail, field welds, unload ballast from the ballast train, surface, line and tamp in lifts, regulate, then destress and the final track inspection.

tasks.desc: Unload ballast from the ballast train
Destress, final inspection and released for service

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Turnouts
modules.desc: Build and install turnouts: assemble the switch, frog and closure panels beside the track, set them in a track-time window, connect, ballast and surface, then adjust and inspect the switch with the signal forces.

tasks.desc: Assemble switch, frog and closure panels
Set and connect in the track window

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Grade crossings
modules.desc: Rebuild or build highway-rail grade crossings: detour and remove the old crossing, rebuild the track section with new ties and ballast, set concrete crossing panels, approach paving, and test the warning devices with the signal forces.

tasks.desc: Detour, traffic control and remove the old crossing

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Tie and surfacing program (track-time windows)
modules.desc: Maintenance-of-way on an operating line: the tie gang replaces ties in work windows between trains, the surfacing gang follows with ballast, tamping and regulating, then slow orders are lifted.

tasks.desc: Pre-plate, distribute ties and slow orders
Lift slow orders and final inspection

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Railroad signals, PTC and communications
modules.desc: Wayside signals and train control: signal houses and cases, track circuits and insulated joints, signals and switch machines, positive train control (PTC) radios and wayside interface units, the cable plant, and the cut-over tests.

tasks.desc: Signal houses and cases on foundations ({LOC})
Signals, track circuits and insulated joints
PTC radios and wayside interface units

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Overhead catenary system (transit electrification)
modules.desc: Light-rail or commuter-rail electrification: pole foundations, poles and cantilevers, contact and messenger wire, registration and tensioning, the traction power substations, and energization tests.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Station platforms
modules.desc: Transit or commuter station platforms: foundations and edge beams, platform slabs with tactile edge, canopies and shelters, lighting and communications, and the platform-train interface checks.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Lighting, traffic signals and ITS
modules.desc: Roadway lighting, traffic signals and intelligent transportation systems: conduit and pull boxes, pole foundations, poles and mast arms, cable, signal heads and controllers, cameras, detection and message signs, fiber, and the burn-in and acceptance tests.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Signing, pavement marking and guardrail
modules.desc: The permanent roadside: ground-mounted and overhead signs, thermoplastic markings and raised pavement markers, guardrail and end treatments, and crash cushions.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Permanent seeding, final inspection and acceptance
modules.desc: Close the job: permanent seeding and landscaping, final clean-up, the owner’s final inspection and punch list, as-built plans and closeout documents, and final acceptance.
modules.author: VissRad
